policy: No prompt/algorithm changes after successful full development or unseen outputs; failed transport/format runs retained. Not a production change.
output_normalization: JSON object or bounded array accepted; copied candidate objects must exactly match original content and valid indices; evidence is always selected from original candidates.
adapter_correction: After the first test run stopped on index-only objects, allow a bounded list of index objects; optional content must still exactly match original. Prompts, model settings, retrieval strategy and frozen test data unchanged. Interrupted test artifact retained; final test is a same-strategy rerun. A second interruption exposed a single-object wrapper array [{indices:[...]}]; unwrap exactly one recognized object. No retrieval prompts, strategy, model settings or dataset changes.
answer_arm_extension: After observing equal all-evidence coverage for rerank-only and expanded-rerank on new topics, add exploratory rerank-only Answer comparison; prompt, references, dataset and retrieval outputs unchanged.
